## Guides

- [Guides | Pratyay Docs](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/): Setup, configuration, and self-hosting guides for Drawy, DrawX, ensor, and other open-source tools by Pratyay Mustafi.
- [DrawX: Offline Whiteboard for Linux | Pratyay Docs](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawx-private-offline-whiteboard-and-planning-app/): DrawX is an offline-first whiteboard for Linux, macOS, and Windows. Draw, plan, and brainstorm locally with no cloud, account, or telemetry.
- [Drawy: Self Hosted Collaborative Whiteboard | Pratyay Docs](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy/): Drawy, a multi tenant Excalidraw with real time collaboration and version history. Covers setup, self-hosting on Cloudflare Workers, and architecture.
- [ensor: Secret Detection & Redaction CLI | Pratyay Docs](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/ensor/): ensor is a Go CLI that finds hardcoded secrets, redacts them with placeholders, and converts env files between dotenv, JSON, YAML, and TOML.
